about_the_game:
At the edge of Africa, humanity's journey begins.
Vast deserts and snowy mountains, swamps and jungles, and countless creatures lurking within.
You must explore unknown lands in search of a new settlement.

There is no mercy here. Hunger tightens its grip on you turn by turn,
and the animals you encounter see you as prey.
A crude axe, a dull spear, a warped bow, and a few stones to throw—
that’s all you have.

Human Planet is a turn-based board game-style survival simulation based on real Earth geography.
Each turn, you must decide whether to take another step forward or hunt to fill your stomach.
Move recklessly, and you will fall to hunger and wounds;
hesitate, and you will become someone’s meal.

Diverse terrains and environments will test your choices,
and battles with wild animals will determine your survival.
Complete this journey with your own survival strategy.

Key Features

  • Journey to a Settlement: Explore uncharted lands starting from Africa.

  • Primitive Survival Combat: Fight animals with axes, spears, bows, and stones.

  • Hunger & Time Pressure: Without smart decisions, you won’t get far.

  • Varied Terrain & Environmental Effects: Snowy mountains, deserts, jungles, swamps—each with unique risks and rewards.

  • Combat & Identification Mini-Games: Hunt, gather, and encounter strange creatures for the first time.

  • Multilingual Support: Korean, English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: 500,000 years ago in the Stone Age, explore uncharted lands in search of a settlement. Survive hunger and predators armed with only crude weapons and your wits.
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean
